items.title: AI is making developers faster. It’s also exposing what’s broken in software delivery
items.summary: Atlassian’s 2026 State of Developer Experience report reveals a disconnect between AI adoption, developer productivity and organisational performance. An engineering leader recently asked me how AI could help their team work more effectively, to keep up with a rapidly growing workload.
